principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class takes on multiple responsibilities: storing the list of shapes and calculating the total area, violating the Single Responsibility Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Consider separating the shape storage logic and area calculation logic, possibly through an interface or separate class handling each responsibility.

principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class depends on concrete implementations (Circle, Square) rather than abstractions, making it difficult to extend with new shapes.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an interface for shapes that provides a method to calculate area, which Circle and Square can implement, allowing AreaCalculator to depend on this interface instead.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
